name: Sensibio H2O Micellar Water
desc: A gentle, no-rinse micellar water that removes makeup and impurities without disrupting the skin's natural barrier — formulated for sensitive skin.
longDesc: Formulated for the most reactive skin types, this iconic micellar water uses patented biomimetic technology to lift away makeup, sunscreen, and daily grime without rubbing or rinsing. It respects the skin's natural pH and helps calm redness and tightness immediately after use, making it a staple first step for sensitive, intolerant, and allergy-prone skin.
fullIngredients: Aqua/Water, Glycerin, and other formulation-specific actives as listed by the manufacturer. (Full INCI ingredient list is provided on the physical product packaging; this is placeholder demo text.)
doctorOpinion: I recommend Sensibio H2O as a first step for almost every patient with reactive or intolerant skin — it's one of the few cleansing waters I've seen genuinely calm redness rather than provoke it. A good baseline product to build a routine around.

name: Sébium Foaming Gel
desc: A purifying foaming cleanser for oily, acne-prone skin that removes excess sebum without over-drying.
longDesc: A gentle-yet-effective foaming cleanser designed specifically for oily and acne-prone skin. It clears away excess sebum and impurities while its Fluidactiv complex works to regulate oil production over time, helping reduce shine and the recurrence of blemishes without stripping the skin barrier.
fullIngredients: Aqua/Water, Glycerin, and other formulation-specific actives as listed by the manufacturer. (Full INCI ingredient list is provided on the physical product packaging; this is placeholder demo text.)
doctorOpinion: For patients with oily, acne-prone skin, this is my go-to recommendation when a foaming cleanser is appropriate. It clears excess oil effectively without the over-drying rebound that often worsens acne in the long run.

name: Atoderm Cream
desc: A rich, fast-absorbing body and face cream that restores comfort to very dry, fragile skin.
longDesc: A rich, ultra-nourishing cream that replenishes lipids in very dry to extremely dry skin. Its patented AtoDerm complex helps restore the skin's protective barrier, reducing tightness and discomfort within days of regular use, and is suitable for use on both face and body, including for sensitive and reactive skin.
fullIngredients: Aqua/Water, Glycerin, and other formulation-specific actives as listed by the manufacturer. (Full INCI ingredient list is provided on the physical product packaging; this is placeholder demo text.)
doctorOpinion: Patients with chronic dryness or barrier-compromised skin consistently report real relief with Atoderm within the first week. It's rich without feeling occlusive, and I often pair it with gentler cleansers for eczema-prone patients.

name: Node Anti-Dandruff Shampoo
desc: A soothing shampoo that reduces flaking and scalp irritation with regular use.
longDesc: A soothing, frequent-use shampoo that gently cleanses the scalp while reducing flaking and the itch-scratch cycle associated with dandruff. Free from harsh sulfates, it's gentle enough for daily use while remaining effective against persistent scalp flaking.
fullIngredients: Aqua/Water, Glycerin, and other formulation-specific actives as listed by the manufacturer. (Full INCI ingredient list is provided on the physical product packaging; this is placeholder demo text.)
doctorOpinion: A well-tolerated option for patients who need frequent washing but still deal with flaking — I recommend it particularly for those who find medicated shampoos too harsh for daily use.

name: Foaming Facial Cleanser
desc: A foaming gel cleanser with ceramides and niacinamide that removes excess oil without disrupting the skin barrier.
longDesc: Developed with dermatologists, this foaming gel cleanser removes excess oil and impurities from normal to oily skin while three essential ceramides and niacinamide work to maintain and restore the skin's natural barrier — so your skin feels clean, never tight or stripped.
fullIngredients: Aqua/Water, Glycerin, and other formulation-specific actives as listed by the manufacturer. (Full INCI ingredient list is provided on the physical product packaging; this is placeholder demo text.)
doctorOpinion: CeraVe's ceramide-based cleansers are among the most frequently recommended in my practice — the science is solid, the formulations are consistent, and patients rarely react badly to them, even with compromised skin barriers.

name: Hydrating Facial Cleanser
desc: A non-foaming, gentle cleanser with hyaluronic acid and ceramides for normal to dry, sensitive skin.
longDesc: A non-foaming, soap-free cleanser that removes dirt and makeup while helping restore the protective skin barrier. Formulated with hyaluronic acid to attract moisture and ceramides to lock it in, this cleanser is gentle enough for daily use on normal to dry, sensitive skin.
fullIngredients: Aqua/Water, Glycerin, and other formulation-specific actives as listed by the manufacturer. (Full INCI ingredient list is provided on the physical product packaging; this is placeholder demo text.)
doctorOpinion: This is my default cleanser recommendation for dry or sensitive skin patients starting a new routine. It cleanses without stripping, which matters enormously for anyone already dealing with barrier issues.

name: Moisturizing Cream
desc: A rich, non-greasy 24-hour moisturizer with three essential ceramides to help restore the skin barrier.
longDesc: A rich, 24-hour moisturizing cream with a unique blend of three essential ceramides that helps restore and maintain the skin's natural barrier. MVE delivery technology provides a continuous release of moisturizing ingredients, making it ideal for very dry to normal skin on the face and body.
fullIngredients: Aqua/Water, Glycerin, and other formulation-specific actives as listed by the manufacturer. (Full INCI ingredient list is provided on the physical product packaging; this is placeholder demo text.)
doctorOpinion: One of the most well-studied moisturizers available over the counter. I recommend it routinely for eczema, post-procedure care, and simply as a reliable daily moisturizer for dry to normal skin.

name: SA Renewing Lotion
desc: A lightweight lotion with salicylic acid that gently exfoliates rough, bumpy skin while moisturizing.
longDesc: A lightweight, fast-absorbing lotion that combines salicylic acid with ceramides to gently exfoliate rough, bumpy skin texture (including keratosis pilaris) while restoring hydration and barrier function — without the irritation typically associated with exfoliating acids.
fullIngredients: Aqua/Water, Glycerin, and other formulation-specific actives as listed by the manufacturer. (Full INCI ingredient list is provided on the physical product packaging; this is placeholder demo text.)
doctorOpinion: Useful for patients dealing with rough, bumpy skin texture — the combination of salicylic acid with ceramides means we get gentle exfoliation without the irritation I'd otherwise worry about.

name: Resurfacing Retinol Serum
desc: An encapsulated retinol serum that smooths texture and fine lines overnight, formulated to minimize irritation.
longDesc: A nightly resurfacing serum with encapsulated retinol, designed to smooth the appearance of post-acne marks and uneven texture while minimizing common retinol irritation. Ceramides and niacinamide help maintain barrier comfort throughout your retinization journey.
fullIngredients: Aqua/Water, Glycerin, and other formulation-specific actives as listed by the manufacturer. (Full INCI ingredient list is provided on the physical product packaging; this is placeholder demo text.)
doctorOpinion: A sensible entry point for patients new to retinoids. The encapsulation technology genuinely reduces the irritation I see with stronger prescription retinoids, making it easier for patients to stay consistent.

name: Skin Renewing Vitamin C Serum
desc: A brightening serum with pure vitamin C and hyaluronic acid to even tone and support collagen production.
longDesc: A potent brightening serum combining 10% pure L-ascorbic acid with hyaluronic acid to visibly brighten skin tone, soften the look of fine lines, and support the skin's natural collagen production — formulated to minimize the sting often associated with vitamin C serums.
fullIngredients: Aqua/Water, Glycerin, and other formulation-specific actives as listed by the manufacturer. (Full INCI ingredient list is provided on the physical product packaging; this is placeholder demo text.)
doctorOpinion: I recommend this to patients looking to address dullness or early pigmentation who haven't tolerated vitamin C serums well in the past — the formulation is better buffered than most drugstore options.

name: Dandruff Relief Shampoo
desc: A medicated shampoo that targets flaking and itch while being gentle enough for daily use.
longDesc: A medicated, dermatologist-developed shampoo that relieves itching and flaking from dandruff, while ceramides and niacinamide help maintain scalp barrier health for comfortable, ongoing use.
fullIngredients: Aqua/Water, Glycerin, and other formulation-specific actives as listed by the manufacturer. (Full INCI ingredient list is provided on the physical product packaging; this is placeholder demo text.)
doctorOpinion: A reasonable maintenance option for mild to moderate dandruff, especially for patients who want to avoid the drying effect of stronger medicated shampoos with long-term use.

name: Effaclar Duo Acne Treatment
desc: A dual-action gel that targets acne and helps reduce the appearance of post-acne marks.
longDesc: A dual-action leave-on treatment gel that targets active blemishes with micro-exfoliating LHA while niacinamide works to visibly reduce the appearance of post-acne marks — formulated to be non-comedogenic and suitable for sensitive, acne-prone skin.
fullIngredients: Aqua/Water, Glycerin, and other formulation-specific actives as listed by the manufacturer. (Full INCI ingredient list is provided on the physical product packaging; this is placeholder demo text.)
doctorOpinion: I frequently suggest Effaclar Duo as an adjunct to prescription acne treatment — the niacinamide component genuinely helps with the post-inflammatory marks that bother patients as much as active breakouts.

name: Anthelios Sunscreen SPF 50
desc: A broad-spectrum, lightweight sunscreen with high UVA/UVB protection for daily wear, even under makeup.
longDesc: An advanced broad-spectrum sunscreen using patented Mexoryl filter technology for superior, photostable UVA/UVB protection. Its fluid, non-greasy texture absorbs quickly and layers seamlessly under makeup, making daily reapplication genuinely pleasant.
fullIngredients: Aqua/Water, Glycerin, and other formulation-specific actives as listed by the manufacturer. (Full INCI ingredient list is provided on the physical product packaging; this is placeholder demo text.)
doctorOpinion: This is the sunscreen I recommend most often when patients tell me they 'hate how sunscreen feels.' The texture compliance alone makes a real difference in whether people actually reapply it.

name: Toleriane Sensitive Cream

longDesc: A fragrance-free daily moisturizer built around La Roche-Posay's prebiotic thermal spring water, designed to soothe reactivity while replenishing the skin barrier — dermatologist-recommended for sensitive and allergy-prone skin, including post-procedure care.
fullIngredients: Aqua/Water, Glycerin, and other formulation-specific actives as listed by the manufacturer. (Full INCI ingredient list is provided on the physical product packaging; this is placeholder demo text.)
doctorOpinion: A dependable choice for patients recovering from procedures or dealing with reactive, easily-irritated skin. Fragrance-free and genuinely gentle, not just labeled as such.

name: Lipikar Balm AP+
desc: An intensive repairing balm for very dry, eczema-prone skin, clinically proven to soothe irritation.
longDesc: An intensive, fast-absorbing balm clinically proven to relieve dryness and discomfort associated with eczema-prone skin. Shea butter and niacinamide soothe irritation, while Microresyl technology helps reduce the recurrence of dry patches with continued use.
fullIngredients: Aqua/Water, Glycerin, and other formulation-specific actives as listed by the manufacturer. (Full INCI ingredient list is provided on the physical product packaging; this is placeholder demo text.)
doctorOpinion: For my eczema patients, this balm is often part of the maintenance plan between flare-ups. It's rich enough to matter but doesn't feel like it's sitting on top of the skin.

name: Pigmentclar Serum
desc: A targeted serum that helps fade dark spots and even out skin tone over time.
longDesc: A targeted serum formulated to visibly reduce the appearance of dark spots, post-acne marks, and uneven skin tone. LHA gently resurfaces while niacinamide and Vitamin CG work beneath the surface to interrupt excess pigment production.
fullIngredients: Aqua/Water, Glycerin, and other formulation-specific actives as listed by the manufacturer. (Full INCI ingredient list is provided on the physical product packaging; this is placeholder demo text.)
doctorOpinion: A solid option for early hyperpigmentation and post-acne marks. I set realistic expectations with patients — visible improvement takes 8-12 weeks of consistent use, but the formulation is sound.

name: Hydro Boost Water Gel
desc: An oil-free, water-based gel moisturizer with hyaluronic acid that hydrates without heaviness.
longDesc: An oil-free gel-cream that instantly quenches dry skin and continues hydrating over time. Its hyaluronic acid-infused formula plumps skin with intense moisture while feeling completely weightless — never greasy or heavy, even in humid climates.
fullIngredients: Aqua/Water, Glycerin, and other formulation-specific actives as listed by the manufacturer. (Full INCI ingredient list is provided on the physical product packaging; this is placeholder demo text.)
doctorOpinion: A good, accessible hydrating option for patients with normal to oily skin who find heavier creams too much. The hyaluronic acid base does real work without adding weight.

name: Rapid Wrinkle Repair Serum

fullIngredients: Aqua/Water, Glycerin, and other formulation-specific actives as listed by the manufacturer. (Full INCI ingredient list is provided on the physical product packaging; this is placeholder demo text.)

name: Gentle Facial Cleanser

longDesc: Free of dyes, fragrance, lanolin, parabens, and formaldehyde, this cleanser was developed for people with the most easily irritated skin. It removes makeup and impurities effectively while leaving skin feeling calm, never tight or reactive.

name: Cicalfate+ Repair Cream

longDesc: A restorative, fast-acting cream that helps soothe and protect skin affected by irritation, minor wounds, or eczema flare-ups. Avène thermal spring water combined with copper and zinc sulfate helps calm compromised skin and support visible recovery.
fullIngredients: Aqua/Water, Glycerin, and other formulation-specific actives as listed by the manufacturer. (Full INCI ingredient list is provided on the physical product packaging; this is placeholder demo text.)

name: Anti-Dandruff Shampoo
desc: A medicated shampoo with ketoconazole that treats and helps prevent dandruff.
longDesc: A clinical-strength, dermatologist-recommended shampoo with 1% ketoconazole that treats the fungus associated with stubborn dandruff at its source — visibly reducing flaking and itch, often within the first few uses.
fullIngredients: Aqua/Water, Glycerin, and other formulation-specific actives as listed by the manufacturer. (Full INCI ingredient list is provided on the physical product packaging; this is placeholder demo text.)
